Anthropologist Michael Masters joins Danny Jones to argue that aliens are future humans and UFOs are time machines. Masters studies how the human form changed over deep time. His claim turns the UFO tale on its head.

Masters says the small grey beings of lore match what our own kin may look like far ahead. He argues the craft are not from far stars but from far years. Jones asks what proof could test such a claim. Listeners get one of the most neat and strange ideas in the field. The library files the talk as an archive record.

Death investigator Joseph Scott Morgan joins Danny Jones to talk about a life spent doing autopsies since he was twenty-one. Morgan has worked death scenes and morgues for decades. He now teaches and tells the tales of the trade.

Morgan tells how a young man walks into the morgue world and what the work does to him. He shares hard cases, odd finds, and the rules he lives by near the dead. Jones asks what most people get wrong about death work. Listeners get a frank, at times funny tour of a grim job. The library keeps the talk as an archive record.
